list_recent_payloads.description: Get the payloads (malware files) URLhaus most recently collected from malware URLs, newest first: up to 1,000 from the last 3 days, each with its MD5 and SHA-256 hashes, file type, malware family when known and VirusTotal detections.
list_recent_payloads.display_str_template: List the newest payloads on URLhaus.
list_recent_payloads.name: list_recent_payloads

parameters.description: Optional. How many payloads to get, newest first: up to 1,000 from the last 3 days. 100 when left empty.
parameters.name: limit

download_url.description: URLhaus's download link for a copy of the file, a ZIP archive holding live malware. It needs the Auth-Key header

file_type.description: The file type URLhaus made out, like exe, doc, elf or zip

first_seen.description: When URLhaus first saw the file (ISO 8601, UTC)

imphash.description: The file's import hash (Windows programs only)

magika.description: The file type Google's Magika made out, like pebin or doc

virustotal.description: VirusTotal's verdict on the file. Empty when VirusTotal has none

detections.description: How many antivirus engines flagged the file

percent.description: The share that flagged it, from 0 to 100

description: Check links, domains and files against URLhaus, abuse.ch's database of websites that spread malware: find out whether a URL is known malware and still online, what a domain or IP address has served, which files a URL dropped and which URLs served a file. Look up tags and malware families, and pull the newest malware URLs and payloads for a blocklist. Needs a free abuse.ch Auth-Key.
